title: The Topsy-Turvy Galaxy, 500 CFA francs

specs.Decoration: microprinting, laser frosting, digital printing, magnifying lens

descriptionPlain: Description Collection minted in collaboration with ESO Observatory High-quality digital printing Decoration with magnifying lens The perfect gift for space enthusiasts In each coin in the series you will find a reflection of the distant galaxies, nebulae and stars that fascinate astronomers and space enthusiasts around the world. More than just collectible treasures, this is a visual odyssey through the macrocosm. Each coin is not only a numismatic work of art, it’s also a window into an infinitely distant world invisible to the human eye. Start your „Galaxies” coin collection today.
